snippet.title: APIDYA' SPECIAL Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
APIDYA' SPECIAL

A legendary shoot-'em-up returns. More than three decades after its original release, one of the most beloved classics of the 16-bit era is back. Completely rebuilt from the ground up for modern platforms. No emulation. No compromises!

Experience the legendary insect-themed adventure like never before, with enhanced visuals, modern features, and the authentic gameplay that made Apidya a cult classic. Explore five unique worlds. 
Battle through meadows, ponds, sewers, cybernetic landscapes, and the lair beyond. Face over twenty unique bosses. Discover hidden stages and expect the unexpected with randomized events that make every journey feel different.

Play your way. Switch seamlessly between HD widescreen and the original 4:3 presentation. Activate authentic retro visual effects, including CRT filters, scanlines, and bloom. Team up in the all-new co-op mode, featuring a fully playable second bee with its own weapons and abilities. 

Celebrate the legacy of Apidya with exclusive physical editions. Including a comprehensive History Artbook and the ultimate Chris Hülsbeck soundtrack collection featuring:

- The complete original soundtrack
- Newly produced studio versions
- And original Amiga recordings from the historic release

Whether you're returning to a cherished classic or discovering it for the first time. The legend is ready to fly again. APIDYA' SPECIAL Launching August 25th, 2026.

Pre-orders are available now and here: http://www.iningames.com
